acceptance.text: Multi-session PTY: two terminal sessions run concurrently with isolated output.
Real runtime: session registry accepts only claude|codex|opencode; missing executable returns BLOCKED.
pnpm: UI dev tooling and scripts use pnpm.
A2A facts are persisted in a Harness-owned filesystem protocol, while task/session runtime state remains under task capsules.
Backend exposes runtime detection for claude/cc, codex, opencode, openclaw, and pi with executable path, version/status, launchability, capabilities, and blocked reason.
Backend exposes terminal control/read tools with bounded range reads, terminal event globbing, session listing, and attach-gated input forwarding.
Workflow UI shows a CEO leader to manager/subagent/worker hierarchy derived from task, dispatch, A2A, and session data rather than a free-edit dependency canvas.
Agents UI auto-detects CLI runtimes, shows their status/capabilities, can launch supported sessions into isolated Web terminals, and links sessions back to workflow observability.
The header uses the Harness H brand icon and the UI removes broken placeholder glyphs from core controls.

decisions: Prefer a browser UI served by a local Node server over trying to display a native Windows terminal.
Use loopback-only HTTP plus WebSocket, with project task capsules as the durable source of truth.
Treat WebSocket events as invalidation hints; refresh canonical state through HTTP snapshots after reconnect or seq gaps.
Default terminal mode is watch/read-only; attach mode is explicit.
Use Motion for React via the current `motion/react` import shape when implementing Framer Motion-style micro-interactions.
ARCHITECT OVERRIDE: Ship Option A (package-hosted UI runner) instead of PLAN default Option C (hybrid). Zero dep pollution, matches existing tool model.
ARCHITECT ADDITION: Insert MVP step 2.5 — auth-gated server skeleton (health + project + token validation) before task API.
ARCHITECT ADDITION: WS keepalive required — ws:ping/pong every 15-30s, lost pong → disconnected state + HTTP snapshot refresh.
ARCHITECT ADDITION: Standard error envelope { error: { code, message, details? } } for all API error responses.
PNPM: UI development uses pnpm; root repo retains npm for publishing.
IPv4-only: MVP binds 127.0.0.1 only. IPv6 is out of scope, not a blocker.
Real runtime PTY: command allowlist is claude|codex|opencode only. No fake agents in product protocol.
Multi-session: /ws/terminal/:sessionId isolates each peer terminal channel.
Vite version: MVP uses Vite 6 (not Vite 8). Vite 8/Rolldown is a future upgrade.
xterm.js / React Flow: NOT yet in MVP deps. Workflow graph route is placeholder, terminal uses textarea renderer.
A2A default: filesystem is the authoritative cross-agent communication layer; skills/scripts provide bounded terminal and event reads for agents.
A2A default: wf-ui manages terminal sessions it starts or sessions explicitly registered through Harness capsules/bridges; unmanaged OS terminals are out of MVP scope.
Runtime default: claude/cc, codex, and opencode are launch-capable when detected; openclaw and pi are detectable but adapter-needed until a concrete launch contract exists.
PM acceptance: the core product shape is a Harness Control Plane where backend/scripts own A2A communication and UI only observes/controls backend state.
risks: No local apple-design skill was found in this repo; CC must use it only if available in its own environment, otherwise follow explicit UI constraints.
node-pty is optional and native; missing adapter must produce a visible BLOCKED state, not a silent fallback to noninteractive CLI mode.
Cross-runtime subagent internals are not guaranteed observable; peers must report nested state through capsule files.
IPv6: out of scope for MVP, 127.0.0.1 only.
WS no keepalive: silent disconnect only detected on next user action unless ws:ping/pong is added.
Token no timeout: process-lifetime token acceptable for loopback but should be documented.
